edition: NCWRC 2025 estimated peak conception map; samples collected through May 2025
metric: Estimated county peak conception date, not the complete breeding season, an observed movement week, or a live report
quality: Precision depends on reproductive sample size. Considerable variation occurs within any area, and some does conceive well before or after the estimated peak. Source says little variation in annual peak timing because shortening day length, rather than weather events including moon phase, triggers estrus.
boundaryEdition: 2024 Census cartographic boundaries, 1:20 million; borders approximate
extraction: 2025 map page 1 dates manually transcribed from rendered original at high resolution; sample counts extracted from native/OCR page 2 table. All 100 county names matched Census names and samples total 1776. Graham has 1 sample and no date shown, so peak is null.
reviewNote: Durham label is partly overlapped by thick season-zone border; final 13 is legible and transcribed Nov-13. The county image crops are retained for independent review. No season-zone assignment has been inferred from color or line placement.
ownership: Agency species page links this official NCWRC PDF. Underlying factual dates and counts extracted, map art not republished. No explicit open license located. Census boundaries are a US federal public dataset.
